## Summary

- What skill(s) does this add or change?
- Why?

## Checklist

- [ ] `SKILL.md` frontmatter `name` matches the folder name
- [ ] Description includes WHAT + WHEN (third person, trigger keywords)
- [ ] `SKILL.md` stays concise; long material in `references/`
- [ ] Ran `npm run check` (validate + catalog)
- [ ] Updated related docs if needed (README / CONTRIBUTING)
